note: The login goes out as the socket opens.
The first binary frame authenticates the session.
The socket drops with both instruments registered on it.
The socket is back and its login unanswered: the feed is not connected yet, as in the backoff, so nothing a client changes now reaches this socket or the feed.
RELIANCE goes while the feed is not connected: only the registry hears of it, and the feed still holds its wire key.
The replay is what clients still hold: INFY alone.
INFY streams again, and its frame shows the session is up before the next subscribe.
The feed is connected and INFY registered again, so this release goes to the broker as usual.
Nobody holds ('N', 2885) any more, so the NFO contract with that code is not refused.
The scrip's packets are the NFO contract's.
